scorecard.rationale: The paper-filtered coffee crossover reported less acute mental fatigue in healthy habitual users. Fortified decaf in a small post-nap crossover also favored less fatigue. The pooled driving studies had an inconclusive fatigue response, and abrupt decaf replacement produced higher fatigue in one residential group. Controlled isolated-caffeine studies report less task fatigue after overnight abstinence in habitual and low-use volunteers, with separate positive doses. Other studies show a weaker or unclear isolated caffeine pattern and alternative withdrawal interpretations. Stroke participants received instant coffee, but the endpoint was balance. The older-adult exertion comparisons differ by abstinence period and design, and the Parkinson caffeine trial interval spans both directions. Together the strongest beverage-related results retain a minimal easing signal with no direct brewed-coffee Parkinson fatigue trial.
